ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the C2-2,
Motor Vehicle-Related Commercial District symbols and indications as shown on Map
No. 15-H in the area bound by:

West Devon Avenue; a line 273.3 feet west of and parallel to North Hoyne
Avenue; the alley next south of and parallel to West Devon Avenue; and North
Bell Avenue,

to those of a B3-2, Community Shopping District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

Oud.
